description: Verified RELEASED fills for shelf games that currently have no date in the RELEASED map in index.html. Each Gameye date was checked against Wikidata and/or Wikipedia North American (or worldwide, when the launch was worldwide) release dates. Do not overwrite dates already in RELEASED. Store each fill under released_key (sitedata nkey + '|' + system) as [month, day, year], the same shape the site already uses: day 0 means month and year only, and [0, 0, year] means year only (released_text() must be extended for that last case).

fills.title: Batman Forever
sources: Wikipedia 'Batman Forever (video game)' infobox: SNES, Game Boy, Game Gear, Genesis/Mega Drive {{vgrelease|NA/EU|September 7, 1995|JP|October 27, 1995}}, citing a GamePro September 1995 ad ('THE REAL GAME BEGINS THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 7TH').
fills.note: The same Wikipedia page also covers the SNES version, which Gameye dated 1995-08-07. That SNES Gameye date does not match this September 7 NA/EU date, so the SNES copy is not in this file.
